title: Policy advocacy for the DAO ecosystem to the government

ms.promise:
1. Collect and benchmark 10 case studies of resource distribution using DAOs that can be applied to the non-profit sector.
2. Conduct interviews with at least three practitioners or researchers involved in the above.
3. Based on the above, draft a guideline framework for implementing DAO-based resource distribution in non-profit projects in Japan.
ms.criteria:
1. The 10 benchmark case studies are reported, including specific distribution algorithms.
2. The contents of the interviews, next action plans, and new inputs are each documented in reports.
3. The table of contents and overall direction of the guideline are clearly defined.
